chunks: Whoever begins the morning healthy in his body, unhindered and secure in his dwelling, and possessing the sustenance of his day, then it is as though the world has been gathered for him.

key_terms.حِيزَتْ لَهُ ٱلدُّنْيَا: the world being gathered and secured for a person
key_terms.قُوتُ يَوْمِهِ: the sustenance sufficient for one day
key_terms.مُخَلًّى فِي سَرْبِهِ: being secure and left untroubled in one’s surroundings or dwelling
key_terms.مُعَافًى فِي بَدَنِهِ: being sound and healthy in one’s body

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام say about health, safety, and daily sustenance?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that bodily health, personal security, and sufficient daily provision are immense blessings. It encourages recognizing contentment in basic necessities, as possessing them is like having the whole world gathered for oneself.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5916 - Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha (as) said:
"Whoever begins his day in good health, secure in his surroundings, and has the sustenance for his day, it is as if the entire world has been gathered for him."
